purpose: Declare the canonical internal interfaces that own network topology, runtime observation, DNS bundle rendering and provider fallback probing so Python organs stop acting as implicit authorities.

target_crate.why: Canonical per-machine network truth and bounded actuation belong to cynic-node, not to mutable Python organ glue.

ports.responsibility: Read canonical network topology and provider fallback declarations from organism desired state.
Observe local WireGuard, routes, runtime health and canonical mesh status without mixing transport into domain policy.
Render canonical DNS activation bundles and deterministic records for Synapse service naming.
Probe provider-plane route and socket fallback status without becoming canonical service-plane authority.

port_rules: Each canonical port must be declared here before new network logic is added to organ-fleet or organ-wireguard.
A Python function group may target cynic-node only through one or more declared ports here.
Ports define responsibilities, not CLI commands or MCP tool names.
Adapters may call systemctl, ip, wg, nmcli or sockets; the port definitions must stay transport-neutral.
